channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Paramount and state AGs settle lawsuit, allowing Warner Bros. merger to proceed
item.description: The antitrust lawsuit threatened to delay Paramount's acquisition until mid-2027 and to cost the company hundreds of millions of dollars in fees.

item.title: AMD hits $1 trillion market cap for the first time as stock rides 5-day rally
item.description: AMD has had a monster 2026 with the stock up more than 180% so far.

item.title: White House TV pool won't cover Trump after press ban: CNN
item.description: The decision comes as CNN, MS NOW and Politico said they are suing Trump to overturn his new ban of those three media outlets from the White House.

item.title: Flights disrupted into Newark, New York, Philadelphia after cut Verizon cable
item.description: An FAA equipment problem snarled air travel at Newark Liberty International Airport and Philadelphia International Airport Monday.

item.title: Meta's Muse personal AI agent tops ChatGPT, Grok and Claude for post-launch downloads
item.description: Meta's Muse AI personal agent tool had 730,000 downloads over the roughly five days after its launch.

item.title: Morgan Stanley's top picks list trounced the S&P 500 the last 12 months. Here are the new members
item.description: The firm refreshed its annual list of top stock ideas after last year’s picks beat the broad market.

item.title: Eli Lilly CEO says 700,000 new seniors have started GLP-1s after Medicare coverage, and 70% are on Lilly drugs
item.description: They're the latest metrics on how much the new Medicare coverage is expanding access to GLP-1 medicines since it launched in July.

item.title: Trump says DOJ will rein in AI 'if we have to'
item.description: President Trump has touted development of artificial intelligence by U.S. companies as a competitive advantage over China that he wants to maintain.

item.title: Trump admin won't give AI leaders a 'liability shield,' Bessent tells CNBC
item.description: Bessent spoke with CNBC's "Squawk Box" about AI safety concerns and this week's summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump.

item.title: Stock boom is fueling a ‘retirement party,’ economists say — what it means for workers
item.description: Stocks have surged and the resulting "wealth effect" has led older workers to retire at a faster clip.

item.title: Trump to meet with NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Monday ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The mayor's press office said the meeting will take place at Gracie Mansion and "will focus on issues affecting New York City and New Yorkers."

item.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian to head to New York for UN meeting as Trump warns of no-deal consequences
item.description: Trump threatened to destroy Iran's economy or eliminate its leadership if Tehran doesn't strike a deal, complicating efforts at diplomacy.

item.title: What is the White House press pool and why does it matter?
item.description: Trump's media ban on three news outlets could limit the public's visibility into the president's actions.

item.title: AI stock valuations may have peaked. Trivariate Research thinks these shares can keep working
item.description: Revenue growth could more than offset anticipated contractions in stock multiples for some key AI stocks over the next few years

item.title: Eli Lilly CEO tells CNBC one-third of new GLP-1 pill patients are taking Foundayo, as drugmaker ramps up production
item.description: Eli Lilly is trying to catch up in the GLP-1 pill market to Novo, which got a head start in the space.

item.title: Nissan eyes increasing U.S. production as new Rogue hybrid launches
item.description: Nissan has two production shifts at its assembly plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, and adding another could mean hundreds, if not thousands, of new jobs.

item.title: Bitcoin hits highest level since January at $86,000, as the market debates whether the 'crypto winter' is over
item.description: Bitcoin rose above $86,000 on Monday extending a rally over the past few days.

item.title: U.S.-listed Greenland stocks surge after Trump announces security deal with Denmark
item.description: The rally followed a U.S.-Denmark-Greenland security pact aimed at expanding the military presence on the Arctic territory.

item.title: ‘It's awful’: How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies
item.description: Tariffs, fuel prices and interest rates are squeezing American companies, particularly manufacturers, auto suppliers, retailers and transportation businesses.

item.title: These Gen Z-approved investment funds are having a moment—what investors should know
item.description: Themed ETFs for industries like AI and energy are coming back into favor and are especially popular with Gen Z investors. Here are a few tips to keep in mind.

item.title: Intel surges 12% as CPU stocks rally. Here's what's driving the move
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch, an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: The 1 thing YNAB founder Jesse Mecham says can help you manage money better
item.description: Knowing what your money is doing is key to reducing financial stress. YNAB founder Jesse Mecham speaks to CNBC Select about fostering financial awareness.

item.title: Kind Snacks founder Daniel Lubetzky: The No.1 piece of advice I give my kids about failure
item.description: Kind Snacks founder and "Build or Break" host Daniel Lubetzky reveals the lessons about success and failure that he imparts to his children.

item.title: Soccer superstar Kylian Mbappé on ending 20-year journey with Nike: 'It was time to change'
item.description: Soccer Champion Kylian Mbappé said he was ready for "change" after ending his association with Nike and entering a deal with Swiss sportswear brand On.

item.title: Here's what the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown means for Asia's biggest crude importers
item.description: The shutdown of Saudi's key East-West pipeline stands to squeeze crude supply for Asian importers, with South Korea appearing the most directly exposed.

item.title: Russia’s pro-Putin party set to win election as Ukraine exposes war’s growing reach into Moscow
item.description: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia on the State Duma election’s final day, including hundreds targeting Moscow.

item.title: German voters turn to left and far-right as 'disaster' for ruling CDU threatens pro-growth reforms
item.description: Another local election drubbing for the ruling CDU has increased political instability and threatens growth prospects, economists said.

item.title: Volkswagen woes deepen as blue-chip index exit follows latest profit warning
item.description: Deutsche Bank analysts said the cut to VW's operating profit forecast initially looks severe but keeps cash generation intact.

item.title: Chinese biopharma stocks jump as U.S. weighs keeping door open to drug deals
item.description: Chinese biopharma stocks rose on Monday after a report that the U.S. may continue to allow most drug licensing deals with Chinese firms.

item.title: Trump says his planned arch would become a 'military complex' able to host drones and snipers
item.description: It is another example of how Trump is insisting that his initiatives to beautify the White House and the city also serve a defensive purpose.
